slice_contract.real_problem: The root, read-only child, and Writer can spend repeated search/read turns locating files before an effective edit even though the Host can derive a bounded deterministic repository working set from the frozen TaskContract and current Git facts.
acceptance: freeze working_set_off and working_set_on as the only treatment delta through the existing temporary typed context.working_set setting and one immutable production binary
reuse the exact six M9-B repository, TaskContract, tool, verifier, model, reasoning, request-budget, and actor-lane contracts with three fresh runs per variant and task

record exact root and child system-prompt block identity, stable-prefix identity, first effective edit, discovery/search/read repetitions, terminal and Store facts, no-credential SQLite reopen, external verifier, usage, cost, and wall time before deriving labels
stop before the next arm on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer ambiguity, safety ambiguity, or any physical-attempt uncertainty; maximum_reruns remains zero

admit the Working-Set selector only when verified success is non-inferior in every positive stratum, false success is zero, safety rejection does not regress, route/lane/reopen conformance is complete, aggregate pre-edit discovery falls by at least fifteen percent with median at least one call lower, repeated work does not increase, and cache-miss input, known cost, or median wall time improves
slice_contract.single_owner: crates/context ContextBroker measured by scripts/eval-m9b-fixed-pro-regression.py over the canonical AgentApplication -> AgentRuntime -> RunStore chain
slice_contract.old_path: root and child agents repeatedly discover repository scope without a Host-derived bounded task-aware map
cutover_deletion: if admitted, make the single bounded selector unconditional for eligible coding TaskContracts, then delete working_set_enabled, context.working_set, the TUI/config treatment surface, and off/on-only tests after real callers migrate

if rejected, delete the selector, production caller, temporary config, candidate fixture/benchmark consumers, and M10-B-only Harness branch while preserving the immutable manifest, decision summary, and any required 0600 raw evidence
forbidden: a RepoGraph crate, embedding, vector database, LLM reranker, second evaluator, ContextBroker, Runtime, Store, model route, Provider, FIM surface, classifier, or dynamic router
selective reruns, mate completion, historical raw splicing, model or reasoning changes, project-pack changes, or a cost claim after unknown billing

formal_schedule.schedule_semantics: six balanced rounds; every task receives exactly three working_set_off and three working_set_on fresh repositories; each round interleaves three control and three treatment arms; maximum_reruns=0

identity: one clean candidate revision and one immutable codewhale binary for all 36 arms
working_set_off and working_set_on use explicit 0600 config files in isolated homes; context.working_set is the only treatment delta and project context pack stays enabled
all task, actor, tool, verifier, model, reasoning, endpoint, request budget, source, schedule, and binary identities match this manifest
measurement: control has no Working-Set marker; treatment positive root requests have exactly one bounded marker/body; the safety counterexample abstains; the marker never enters the stable prefix
terminal, canonical Store, no-credential SQLite reopen, external verifier, first effective edit, discovery repetition, usage, cost, and prompt identity are durable before arm derivation
accounting complete=true, usage_complete=true, billing_unknown=false, unpriced=false, sealed=true, in_flight=0, and started=completed for every physical attempt
quality: verified success is non-inferior overall and in every positive stratum
false success is zero in both variants and safety correct rejection does not regress
root, read-only child, Writer, recovery, latest revision evidence, route audit, and SQLite reopen conformance are complete
efficiency: aggregate discovery calls before first effective edit fall by at least fifteen percent and their median falls by at least one call
aggregate discovery calls, repeated search/read signatures, and aggregate/median model requests do not increase
aggregate cache-miss input, aggregate known cost, or median wall time improves

decision_rule.admit: keep_budgeted_working_set only when all 36 arms are measurement-valid and every identity, quality, conformance, localization, and efficiency hard gate passes
decision_rule.reject: reject_budgeted_working_set when the complete matrix fails any quality or efficiency gate; delete the selector and all treatment paths
decision_rule.stop_incomplete: on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer failure, safety ambiguity, cost ceiling, or any pre-registered hard gate; do not rerun, complete a mate, resume, resample, or splice
non_conclusions: this experiment does not evaluate nested scoped rules, Acceptance Progress, typed recovery, environment artifacts, Auto, Flash routing, FIM, Provider, or multi-Agent admission
offline localization scores or one successful arm cannot admit the selector
unknown billing cannot support a cost or product conclusion
